notes.title: VidyGames Dev: What’s Next?
notes.content:
[h2]📣ANNOUNCEMENT TIME! [/h2]

Hey everyone! 

Making a new game –[b] SYNTHESIS OF CORRUPTION[/b] – FPS with survival horror elements.

Please Wishlist and Follow.

Demo is coming soon, I hope.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3629200/Synthesis_of_Corruption/

[hr][/hr]

[b]SYNTHESIS OF CORRUPTION[/b] is horror-FPS hybrid, gameplay wise is closer to Half-Life 1(but slow-paced) mixed with Lost in Vivo/Cry of Fear.

The game’s low poly aesthetics resemble late 90’s games (heavily inspired by HL1/GoldSrc), with some modern post-processing enhancements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230229/b3ecc6f537534b63c99c498facb94bec01dbec3e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230229/28c2f5dffea2a374f4907fe052d211bac8277879.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230229/8241950bab9141c9ebfdbad7ce5a412f35f8a0b5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230229/70e95896382adc454a214cfb57f4b5a9ec652ee8.png[/img]


[h2]Some other news.[/h2]

Regarding my other game in development: Plastomorphosis sequel is currently on hiatus due to technical reasons (I need more RAM, I guess, or even better hardware)…

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310520/Plastomorphosis_Final_Corruption


[b]The project is not completely halted;[/b] it simply needs improved circumstances for further progress.

[hr][/hr]

[b]I also want to thank everyone who played my other games and left a (positive) review. 
It is essential for me to evaluate how the experience can be improved and identify areas for growth to create better games.[/b]

Thanks everyone, stay safe and play indie games.

notes.title: "Snowsquall Grip" is out NOW on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2]Immerse yourself in a chilling horror/thriller experience with PSX-style crispy graphics. In this short game, you’ll find yourself lost during a sudden snowstorm.[/h2]

[b]
[list]
[*] Primary genre: Walking Simulator
[*] Intuitive Physics-Based Item Interaction
[*] Straightforward Puzzles
[*] Low on Jumpscares: Emphasis on Atmospheric Exploration
[*] Don’t Freeze: Keep Your Sanity in the Midst of the Snowsquall
[/list]
[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3000420
